question.text: Operating expenses excluding brokerage, over and above management fees, are capped at:

answer.text: 0.50% per annum of client's average daily AUM

explanation.text: The Logic: Operating expenses excluding brokerage, over and above PMS fees, shall not exceed 0.50% per annum of the client's average daily AUM. The Trap: Higher caps such as 1.00% or 2.50% are not permitted under this limit. Note: The cap applies to operating expenses excluding brokerage; it is measured against the client's average daily AUM.
